This is compatible with successful fresh-data technical recovery; public snapshots do not expose the private technical retry request/claim records, so exact retry scheduling attribution remains unproven.
Actual entry fill19:13:54.251 and maximum-holding-time exit reservation19:28:55.089 precede a matching actual PAPER sell fill19:28:56.225.
The same f96 source/configuration/run generated the whole natural lifecycle; new arming v2 source had not been deployed and receives no credit.
Protection counters ended at2243ms maximum completed gap,75ms maximum quote age,0breaches and0unavailable checks. Flat/no pending is observed after sell.
Existing one-position/four-deep-slot limits remained unchanged; there is no demonstrated multiple-position capability here.
Global MONITORING_UNAVAILABLE while held is consistent with known f96 permission-versus-position-capacity coupling; it is not evidence of missing position protection.

Whole-account historical balances and trade-level USD row amounts are retained, but exact per-trade reconciled P&L cannot be proved from these public aggregates. Costs, deposit assets and SOL/USD timestamps must not be combined into an invented return.
Cloud sampler interruptions create real gaps in interactive supervision; the data does not establish an uninterrupted acceptance interval.
